cohort: Pregnant women with HS (n = 998) and 5:1 age-matched pregnant women without HS (n = 5065)
finding: Compared to women without HS, pregnant women with HS had significantly lower odds of having a live birth and significantly higher odds of having elective terminations, gestational hypertension, and cesarean deliveries, and of receiving HS designated treatment during pregnancy.
mod_finding: Pregnant women with HS had significantly higher odds of cesarean deliveries.
